iti49:1.1: 12 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti49:2.1: dvīhi bhikkhave diṭṭhigatehi pariyuṭṭhitā devamanussā oliyanti eke atidhāvanti eke cakkhumanto ca passanti.
iti49:3.2: bhavārāmā bhikkhave devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na sampasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati
iti49:4.2: bhaveneva kho paneke aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti
iti49:4.3: yato kira bho ayaṃ attā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā
iti49:4.4: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ etaṃ yāthāvanti
iti49:5.3: bhūtaṃ bhūtato disvā bhūtassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
iti49:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave cakkhumanto ca passantīti.
iti49:8.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
